# A2UI fixtures

## TL;DR

- Copies of A2UI v1.0's JSON Schemas and its contact form example, for tests.
- Source: [a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui), folder
  `specification/v1_0` (`json/` and `test/cases/`), Apache-2.0.
- Copied unchanged on 2026-11-22; refresh them when A2UI publishes a new
  version, not before.
- Used by `A2uiSurfaceTest`, `A2uiConformanceTest` and `A2uiRendererTest`.

## Files

| File | From |
|------|------|
| `agent_to_renderer.json`, `common_types.json` | `specification/v1_0/json/` |
| `basic_catalog.json` | the basic catalog, published as `catalogs/basic/catalog.json` |
| `contact_form_example.jsonl` | `specification/v1_0/test/cases/` |
